text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ah... Huh?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawawawa~.
In a shocking turn of events, none of the four Umamusume were able to secure a victory.

"Still, this outcome
hinted at a certain truth."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ayabe-san might have been
a little too focused on Opera O-chan.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's why an overlooked girl won.
But... now everything is clear.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Opera is not completely invincible.
It's entirely possible she could lose in the future.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Overlord, Demon King, whatever she is—
she's not an opponent I can't beat in a head-to-head match.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Right!
If we just keep doing what we've built up with Trainer and Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"We can definitely win!
We can definitely surpass them!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Losing is... well, it happens.
What matters is the reason behind it.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Made *me* take notice?
Top Road and Ayabe, so intensely.
That running of theirs was...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be... under threat?
My Millennium Kingdom."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: A kingdom that was supposed to be eternal, brought down by those two...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-san is... being cornered.
By Top Road-san and Ayabe-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
She never makes that kind of face.
At this rate... she might really...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"—No.
Anything but... that."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I always want Opera O-san to be composed
and smiling happily! As my goal.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: —And for that purpose!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan, thank you for the race.
Until next time—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Please make it in autumn! Both Ayabe-san
and I will become much stronger by then.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course! Come on in!
Now then, for the autumn Tokyo performance—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting at the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Let's go, Doto!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, Opera O-san!

T.M. Opera O strode away gallantly.
Meisho Doto scurried along
after her at a jog.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. We can safely assume
the future has opened up for us now, right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: I've gained the confidence that I can keep growing from here on out without losing to Opera O-chan.
choice_data_list: Yeah, looks like we can manage to keep up the fight!
Yeah, looks like we can give them a real run for their money!

text_block_list.text:
Admire Vega's presence truly is significant after all.
Having her around has made the training far more intense.
From here on...

How far the two of us can go...
Whether we can truly reach the real summit.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This year's Autumn G1 campaign—
That's where the real decisive battle lies.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I don't want to lose.
Not to Opera O-chan, and not to Ayabe-san either!

I don't yet know what kind of battle it will be,
or what awaits near the summit. But...

First, we'll aim for our debut race, the Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Let's make sure our preparations are flawless.
